description: A line comment in a JSON string analyzed as a static traversal is ignored
notes: The spec reads the string as a native syntax expression, where a line comment counts as a newline, and doesn't say whether an expression in a string may be followed by one. hashicorp/hcl's scanner makes # c a comment token without a newline, and the peeker drops comment tokens (nextToken in hclsyntax/peeker.go), so hclsyntax.ParseTraversalAbs, called from expression.AsTraversal (json/structure.go), reads just x.
